ICS: Did the teacher give specific examples or precise behaviors in giving their feedback?
Did the teacher offer positive ("reinforcing") feedback?
Did the teacher elicit the reaction of the learner to the feedback?
Did the teacher make good eye contact with the learner?
Did the teacher create a comfortable, respectful learning climate?
Did the teacher listen, as well as talk?
PBLI: Did the teacher try asking the learner to first self-assess?
Was there discussion of an "action plan" (i.e. concrete next steps to take in order to improve)?
PROF: Did the teacher admit his/her own limitations, or acknowledge the inherent limitations of the learner?
